# Evidently AI

> Evidently AI is an AI evaluation and LLM observability platform for testing, monitoring, and validating production AI systems from hallucination detection to red-teaming.

Evidently AI provides both open-source tools and enterprise platforms for comprehensive AI quality assurance. The platform covers LLM evaluation, RAG testing, ML monitoring, and AI agent validation with extensive benchmarks, case studies, and hands-on learning resources.

## Key Topics

- LLM Evaluation
- LLM-as-a-Judge
- RAG Testing
- AI Observability
- ML Monitoring
- Adversarial Testing
- Hallucination Detection
- AI Agent Testing
- Data Quality
- Evidently OSS
- Evidently Cloud
- Red-Teaming
- Test Automation
- AI Debugging
- Synthetic Data Generation

## Core Platform & Products

- [Evidently AI - AI Evaluation & LLM Observability Platform](https://www.evidentlyai.com): Evidently AI homepage: AI evaluation and LLM observability platform for production-ready testing
- [Evidently - Open-Source ML Monitoring and LLM Observability](https://www.evidentlyai.com/evidently-oss): Evidently open-source tool: evaluate, test, monitor AI systems from tabular data to LLM
- [Evidently AI - Pricing](https://www.evidentlyai.com/pricing): Evidently AI pricing plans for AI observability across Gen AI and predictive ML

## LLM & Generative AI Testing

- [LLM Evaluation and Testing Platform | Evidently AI](https://www.evidentlyai.com/llm-testing): LLM testing and evaluation platform: detect hallucinations, safety risks, and quality issues
- [Evidently AI - LLM-as-a-judge: complete guide to LLM evaluators](https://www.evidentlyai.com/llm-judge-guide): Complete guide to LLM-as-a-judge technique, building evaluators, and prompt engineering
- [RAG Testing and Evaluation | Evidently AI](https://www.evidentlyai.com/rag-testing): RAG pipeline testing and evaluation: reduce hallucinations and improve retrieval accuracy
- [LLM Adversarial Testing and Red-Teaming | Evidently AI](https://www.evidentlyai.com/llm-red-teaming): LLM adversarial testing and red-teaming: identify vulnerabilities and security threats
- [AI Agent Testing and Validation | Evidently AI](https://www.evidentlyai.com/ai-agent-testing): AI agent testing and validation: ensure reliable and safe multi-step agent workflows

## ML Monitoring & Observability

- [Evidently AI - Machine Learning Monitoring and Observability](https://www.evidentlyai.com/ml-monitoring): ML monitoring and observability: track data quality, drift, and model performance
